name: knitting-operator-assistant
description: Offline-first PWA and Android app for circular knitting machine operators (Bangla/English).

scripts.validate: npm run check && npm test && npm run build && node scripts/check.mjs --dist
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && cap sync android && node scripts/android-prepare.mjs
scripts.android:build: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
